bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-ui-05849c)" || exit 63
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
new=1e5b41d236ea47de214ed29eeea9477bcec539a6
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$new" || exit 65
file=scripts/userbot_link_rich_flow_smoke.py
test -f "$file" && test ! -L "$file" || exit 66
current="$(git hash-object "$file")"
known=0
for commit in $(git log --format=%H "$new" -- "$file"); do
 test "$current" = "$(git rev-parse "$commit:$file" 2>/dev/null)" && known=1 && break
done
test "$known" = 1 || exit 67
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-rich-register.XXXXXXXX)"
cp "$file" "$tmp/old.py"
git show FETCH_HEAD:"$file" > "$tmp/new.py"
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py"
python3 - "$tmp/new.py" "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:compile(Path(p).read_bytes(),p,"exec")
PY
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  cp "$tmp/old.py" "$root/$file" || true
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
if ! cmp -s "$tmp/new.py" "$file"; then
 cp "$tmp/new.py" "$file"
 swapped=1
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 68
fi
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 69
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 70
ok=1
echo RESIDENT_LINK_RICH_TEST_SCRIPT=PASS
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_SESSION=PASS
echo ORIGINAL_LOCAL_CLIENT=UNMODIFIED
